rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for things becoming intertwined or being mixed together into a tangle.

example.english: These earphone wires always tangle together.
example.traditional: 啲耳機線成日纏埋一齊。
example.jyutping: di1 ji5 gei1 sin3 seng4 jat6 cin4 maai4 jat1 cai4

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a general messy or confused situation.

example.english: The whole thing has turned into a tangle.
example.jyutping: gin6 si6 gaau2 dou3 jat1 tyun4 zou1

rows.note: Use this for a visibly tangled or disordered mass of things rather than an abstract dispute.

example.english: The earphone wires are in a tangle.
example.jyutping: di1 ji5 gei1 sin3 gaau2 dou2 jat1 tyun4 lyun6

rows.note: Use this for the arguing or quarrelling slice of “tangle with someone.”

example.english: I don't want to tangle with him.
example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 soeng2 tung4 keoi5 aai3 gaau1

rows.note: Use this when “tangle with someone” specifically means getting into a physical fight.

example.english: They tangle every time they meet.
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 jat1 gin3 min6 zau6 daa2 gaau1

rows.note: Use this for a conflict or clash, including a serious argument or physical fight.

example.english: They got into a tangle over this matter.
example.traditional: 佢哋兩個因為呢件事發生衝突。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 jan1 wai6 ne1 gin6 si6 faat3 sang1 cung1 dat6
